description: This file defines logging-related classes, functions, and macros for the Thunder project, including a template class for logging categories, external functions for dumping exceptions and system files, and macros for logging control and messaging.

classes.name: BaseLoggingType
classes.description: A template class for logging categories, providing methods to control and query logging status, and access metadata.

methods.name: DumpException
methods.description: External function to dump exception details based on exception type.

methods.name: DumpSystemFiles
methods.description: External function to dump system files for a given process ID.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Static method to announce or activate logging.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the Control type for the logging category.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled for the category.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables logging for the category.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with the logging category.
